reason: This plugin is primarily a Windows desktop automation tool for DeepSeek Harness, focused on observing and controlling active windows via UI Automation and screenshots plus foreground input actions, with an approval/safety model for risky actions and optional allowlisting to constrain usage.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 桌面电脑操作能力，可发现窗口与 UI 元素、获取带网格标注的截图，并执行前台点击和键盘输入等交互。
summaries.en: This plugin provides Windows desktop computer-use support for DeepSeek Harness, enabling window and UI element discovery, grid-based screenshot observation, and foreground mouse and keyboard actions.

capabilities: list and activate Windows application windows
inspect and target UI Automation elements
capture and save screenshots for observation
execute foreground mouse and keyboard actions
apply safety/approval logic for risky operations

reasons.code: Readme states the plugin combines window discovery, UIA element discovery, screenshots, and foreground input actions (clicking/typing/keys) for Windows computer use.
Readme documents an interaction model where the target window is activated to the foreground before input actions, which implies direct desktop control.
Package metadata describes the plugin as a safety-gated Windows Computer Use tool with ModLens visual grounding and native components.
Bundled native helper and verification scripts indicate native runtime interaction with Windows accessibility/screen-capture functionality.
